findings.evidence: `def firstMomentG2 (G : StructureFunctions) (Q2 : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ x in Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, G.g2 x Q2` (Polarized/Basic.lean:143); the proof here is `simp [firstMomentG2]`, i.e. the def must be named explicitly.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to `firstMomentG2_partonModel`. (`firstMomentG1_partonModel` carries an integrability hypothesis and should stay unannotated.)
findings.issue: `firstMomentG2_partonModel : firstMomentG2 (partonModel charge Δ) Q2 = 0` is unconditional and in closed form but carries no `@[simp]`. `firstMomentG2` is a plain `def`, so `simp` cannot reach it via `partonModel_g2`; a goal mentioning `firstMomentG2 (partonModel ...)` is left untouched.

findings.evidence: grep: only `pdfOfSpinDensity_apply` and `helicityPdfOfSpinDensity_apply` exist; `soffer_bound_pdf` (line 288) states `2 * |transversityPdfOfSpinDensity ρ i x Q2| ≤ pdfOfSpinDensity ρ i x Q2 + helicityPdfOfSpinDensity ρ i x Q2`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma transversityPdfOfSpinDensity_apply (ρ) (i) (x Q2) : transversityPdfOfSpinDensity ρ i x Q2 = h1 (ρ i x Q2) := rfl`.
findings.issue: The PR adds `@[simp] pdfOfSpinDensity_apply` (line 255) and `@[simp] helicityPdfOfSpinDensity_apply` (line 266) but no `transversityPdfOfSpinDensity_apply`. The three induced distributions are developed in parallel in this file, so `simp` now normalizes two of them to `f1`/`g1` while leaving `h1` folded — mixed normal forms in exactly the statements that mention all three, e.g. `soffer_bound_pdf`.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:315-318: `refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.integrableOn ?_; simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using h.momentIntegrable 0 i Q2`.
findings.fix: Expose `Regularity.integrable (h : Regularity f) (i) (Q2) : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => f i x Q2) := by simpa only [pow_zero, one_mul] using h.momentIntegrable 0 i Q2`, and define `Regularity.integrableOn := (h.integrable i Q2).integrableOn`.
findings.issue: `Regularity.integrableOn` exports only `IntegrableOn ... (Icc 0 1)`, while its own proof first obtains global `Integrable (fun x => f i x Q2)` from `momentIntegrable 0` and then weakens it. The stronger fact is not reachable from the regularity API without redoing the `simpa`.

summary: The parton-model surface is minimal, bodies are unexposed, and `partonModel_g1`/`partonModel_g2` characterize the definition with `(rfl)`. Three gaps: a missing `@[simp]` on the unconditional `firstMomentG2_partonModel`, an inconsistent `_apply` simp set for the three induced distributions, and `Regularity.integrableOn` exporting a strictly weaker fact than its proof yields.
